parameters.name: Output Gain
parameters.description: Final output volume after all processing (Limit, Saturation).

parameters.name: Gain (Makeup)
parameters.description: Makeup gain applied AFTER compression but BEFORE limiting.

parameters.name: Ratio
parameters.description: Ratio of input to output level above threshold.

parameters.name: Knee
parameters.description: Softness of the transition into compression.

parameters.name: Attack
parameters.description: Time taken to reach full compression ratio.

parameters.name: Release
parameters.description: Time taken to return to zero gain reduction.

parameters.name: Sustain
parameters.description: RMS averaging window length. Prevents fluttering on bass.

parameters.name: Saturation
parameters.description: Threshold where soft-clipping begins before hitting the ceiling.

parameters.name: Attack (Lookahead)
parameters.description: Adds system latency to allow lookahead detection.
